scripts.build: npm run lint && npm run build:js && npm run build:css
scripts.build:js: npm run build:js:readable && npm run build:js:minified
scripts.build:js:readable: webpack ./src/index.js --mode production --output-path . --output-filename plugin-name.js --output-library-name PluginName --output-library-type var --output-library-export default --no-optimization-minimize --no-optimization-split-chunks --no-output-chunk-loading --no-devtool
scripts.build:js:minified: webpack ./src/index.js --mode production --output-path . --output-filename plugin-name.min.js --output-library-name PluginName --output-library-type var --output-library-export default --optimization-minimize --no-optimization-split-chunks --no-output-chunk-loading --no-devtool
